about: DEV set for the brief review (model check on brief text, shared/safety/brief-review.json), 2026-10-24. Written by the safety builder; the review prompt may be shaped on it (as shapes, never quoting it). Includes the T-L1 DEV lines (sets/dev-lint-ai.json) plus crisis-line and manipulation instructions and multi-line snippets. Blind counterpart: heldout-brief-review.json (written by a separate agent, scored once). 2026-10-24: persona-name cases added (items may carry a persona object applied to persona.name/gender) after rejected.2026-10-24.brief-review-flags-persona-names. 2026-10-24b: honest openings, persona-voice notes and prohibition facts (field fact with key) added for open.2026-10-24.brief-review-fp-names-in-notes and rejected.2026-10-24.brief-review-drops-fact-keys; field/key are applied by judge-eval once its hash is free (PREREG-10).
